```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for survival by class and sex
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=data, x='pclass', hue='sex', palette='pastel', order=[1, 2, 3])
plt.title('Survival Count by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Count of Passengers', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(ticks=[0, 1, 2], labels=['First Class', 'Second Class', 'Third Class'], fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Gender', fontsize=12, title_fontsize='13')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
